description: Playas y Faros - WFS is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sig.asturias.es. WFS service with the geolocation of lighthouses and the main beaches of Asturias. Through queries about vector entities it is possible to obtain extended information about each beach or lighthouse, as well as links to photos and tabs in PDF format. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Beaches and Lighthouses - WFS" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include ASTURIAS, PRINCIPADO, Costa, Regiones biogeográficas, Cartografia, SITPA. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WFS. The listing shows 2018-05-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
